bio_en: Hambardzum Terterian was born in 1884 in Topti village near New Nakhichevan (on the Don) and was raised under the influence of his elder brother Hovhannes, a teacher and convinced Dashnak. He studied at the New Nakhichevan diocesan school, the Vladikavkaz gymnasium and the law faculty of St Petersburg University. After the 1917 revolution he became a leading public figure in the Don region, chairing a 2000-strong Cossack congress in 1919, and in 1919 he went to independent Armenia. He took part in the Salvation Committee formed after the uprising of 18 February 1921; his obituary appeared in Alik in January 1956.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death date not stated precisely (obituary in Alik 3 Jan 1956).
